text: Rebus Garluses (Japanese: , Reibasu Garuusu) are enemies in . They are members of the Garlus family, and can be found at level 48 - 50 at the Ardainian Garrison on the Central Plain of Temperantia.
Regel Arachnos (Japanese: , Regīna Supaido) are enemies in . They are members of the Arachno family, and can be found at level 41 - 45 at the Lumos Pillar on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal.
Reeg Tirkin (Japanese: , Regimuzu Tākin) are enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 81-84 at the Old Gelgemos Gate on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Rainbow Gloves (Japanese: , Nijiiro Gurōbu) are accessories in and . They increase the wearer's Dexterity stat by up to 22%. The Hero Gloves, Carbon Gloves, Dress Uniform Mòrag, Scarlet Inquisitor Mòrag and Vivid Mitts accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect. For a similar additive effect that can stack with this gear, check the Leather Gloves and Smithy Gloves accessories.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Recovery Symbols (Japanese: , Rikabarī Shinboru) are accessories in and . They restore up to 60% of every party member's maximum HP when a Chain Attack is initiated.
Rainbow Crystals are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in the Spirit Crucible Elpys, in particular from the Collection Point right after the tunnel's exit from the Bone Road Skip Travel point.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Rebirth Amulets (Japanese: , Saisei no Amyuretto) are accessories in . They increase the amount of HP recovered by the wearer from HP Potions by up to 44%. They are the upgraded version of the Activity Amulet and Healing Amulet accessories.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Red Threads (Japanese: , Akai Ito) are accessories in and . They extend the range of the Affinity Bond between Driver and Blade by up to 1.2 meters, making the bond easier to maintain while moving or when the wearer is inflicted with Stench. The Love Thread and Passion Thread accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect.

The Rampaging Ardun (Japanese: , Bāsaku Arudon) is a Boss in . It is a member of the Ardun family and is fought at level 21 at the Great Blowhole in the Kingdom of Uraya. This is the first battle in which Rex's art Anchor Shot can inflict Topple. This enemy drops no items.
Rapid Twist (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using Twin Rings.
Ransro Aspids (Japanese: , Ransurō Asupīdo) are enemies in . They are members of the Aspid family, and can be found at level 46 - 50 at the Dalnes Stone on the Central Plain of Temperantia.
Rangel Eggs (Japanese: , Rangeru Eggu) are enemies in . They are Eggs, and can be found at level 46-48 at the Penitents' Spring on the Mid Level of the Spirit Crucible Elpys.

Reggl Arachnos (Japanese: , Regio Supaido) are enemies in . They are members of the Arachno family, and can be found at level 40-43 at the Chamber of Offering on the Mid Level of the Spirit Crucible Elpys. Reggl Arachnos are summoned at level 43-45 by Eryagh Pod's art "Emergence" and at level 45 - 47 by Glamorous Alfred's art "Battle Pheromone".

Redom Crustips (Japanese: , Redōmu Shuribu) are enemies in . They are members of the Crustip family, and can be found at level 80-82 at the Sacred Ice Caverns and the Great Pillar Passage on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal. They are only found during misty weather.

Rambl Marrins (Japanese: , Ranbo Mārin) are enemies in . They are members of the Marrin family, and can be found at level 87-89 at the Genbu Drifts on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal during misty weather.
Raloo is an NPC in . Raloo is an Urayan who can be found at the Waypoint Market in the Kingdom of Uraya. Raloo gives the quest Sniff out the Spy.
Ransenion is an NPC in . He is a Tantalese informant, who can be found in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. He's located in the southeast corner of town.

Rare Core Crystals are Core Crystals in . They can awake a common or a rare Blade. They can be obtained from Unique Monsters drops. In the , Rare Core Crystals can also be obtained as rewards for completing Merc Assault Missions and by scanning an amiibo.

Red Collar is a Key Item in . It can be obtained from a Gegl Quadwing at Godsford Isle in the Leftherian Archipelago during the quest Stolen Keepsake, and must be delivered to Dragand. It is a collar that previously belonged to his pet dog, Sally.

Range Boost Up (Japanese: , Shageki Kyori Appu) is an Aux Core in . It increases the range of Ether Cannon-class weapons by up to 5 additional meters. This allows for Auto-Attacks and Arts to reach the maximum possible range of 20 meters and 25 meters, respectively, the largest attack range in the game outside of some Blade Specials. __TOC__

The Ravenous Arachno (Japanese: , Bōshoku no Supaido) is a Quest Exclusive Boss in . It is a member of the Arachno family, and can be found at level 58 in a recess of the Wrecc Marshland in the Gormott Province during the quest The Ties That Bind.

Reener Arachnos (Japanese: , Reina Supaido) are enemies in . They are members of the Arachno family, and can be found at level 33-37 in the Old Industrial District on the Upper Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Rainbow Dumplings are Staple Foods items in . They can be created by Vess at the Vess's Dumplings kitchen at the back of Mabon's house near Tretl Windmill Plaza in Torigoth, Gormott, after raising her "Dumpling Pro" field skill to level 2.
Rahim is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian who can be found art Torigoth Arch in the Gormott Province.
Reez is an NPC in . Reez is an Urayan who can be found at the Royal Guard Barracks in the Kingdom of Uraya.

The Raine Tirkin (Japanese: , Rēn Tākin) are two quest-exclusive enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family and are fought at level 7 by the waterfall close to Seigle Fell in the Gormott Province during the DLC Quest Passion of the Artisan. They assist the Hermit Tirkin.

The Regiderian Tablet is a Key Item in . It is obtained by Salvaging at Triedge Isle on the Central Plain of Temperantia during the quest Lost Kingdom. It gives details on the kingdom of Regideria's downfall.

Reconciliation is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located east of the Titan Weapon Dig Site on top of the closest Aeshma within Temperantia, accessible by climbing the gantry to the north of the Aeshma. The conversation centers on the terms of the treaty between the Empire of Mor Ardain and the Kingdom of Uraya. The conversation choices are "You pay Uraya big fine too?" and "You give Uraya Tasty Sausages?". Both options result in Tora being called stupid.

Rebel's Dagger (Japanese: , Bureibudagā, Lit. "Brave Dagger") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using Brilliant Twinblades. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Rex's Spin of Bravery.
Ranhald is an NPC in . He can be found near the Nharil Central Plaza in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Rebellious Soldiers (Japanese: , Rukusuria Doranku) are quest-exclusive enemies in . They are Tantalese Knights, and can be found at level 70 throughout Theoscaldia Palace in the Kingdom of Tantal during the DLC quest Most Awful News?!. They have the appearance of regular Tantalese Knights, with the exception of their red helmets, signifying that they are rebels.
Raising Trust is an Info Item in . It can be purchased from the Informant shop at the Kedeigh Gate of Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

The Ratchet Tirkin (Japanese: , Rachetto Tākin) are Story Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 26 - 31 in the Old Factory of the Empire of Mor Ardain during Chapter 4.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Rainbow Belts (Japanese: , Reinbō Obi) are DLC accessories in . They extend the duration of the Topple reaction by up to 32% (1.6 seconds). This effect will only apply when the wearer inflicts the reaction. They are the upgraded version of the White Belt, Black Belt and Platinum Belt accessories. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass.

The Reddeth Aligo (Japanese: , Reddohanto Diburo) is a Challenge Battle Enemy in . It is a member of the Aligo that is fought at level 58 during the third wave of the Challenge Battle Tiger! Tiger! IRL. This enemy drops no items.
Randha is a Urayan in . She is the daughter of the Viltsbine Mercs leader. She can be found at the Uraya Merc Barracks in Fonsa Myma of the Kingdom of Uraya.

Raimond is an NPC in . He is a Leftherian who can be found first found at Ysheva Harbor in the Leftherian Archipelago during the DLC quest Bright Spark upon installing the New Quests Pack 4 of the Expansion Pass. He can be then found at the Fonsett Residential Area.
Regal Hunter (Japanese: , Roiyaruhantā, Lit. "Royal Hunter") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when wielding an Uchigatana.

Ralsh Volffs (Japanese: , Rasshu Vorufu) are enemies in . They are members of the Volff family and can be found at level 2-3 in Lasaria Woodland and 7-8 at the Cropwoods of Yorn in the Lasaria Region of the Kingdom of Torna.

Rami is a young Ardainian in . He can be found on the 2nd floor of the left side building when heading into Admar Storage Zone in Alba Cavanich after Crossette is awakened. Approaching him with Crossette, Mòrag, and Pyra in the party results in a conversation which unlocks Crossette's level 2 "Ardent Cooking". Rami is not known to appear at any other time.

Red Pollen Orbs are Key Items in . One is found in Satorl Marsh's Nopon Refuge during the quests A Big Brother's Fight and A Little Brother's Fight. Another is received from Zazadan in the same location during A Mysterious Delicacy.

Ravine Bunnit (Japanese: , Shin'en no Banitto) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Bunnit family and can be found at level 50 in Gormott, on a platform above the Hoary Weald Camp. Several Foray Bunnits spawn alongside it. It is the only Unique Monster in to be named by its species rather than a nickname.

Rainbow Resins are Tree collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna, in particular from the Impressive Tree Collection Point located southeast of the Lasaria Woodland Skip Travel point.
Rarestones are Ore collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna.

Red Pollen Orbs are Flower collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna. They become a growing problem before the events of the game, and when the party meets Macmac she gives the quest A Rare Sense of Justice, requiring the destruction of green barrels around Torna and Gormott in order to eradicate the pollen orb smuggling that has been going on.
The Rainbow Blossom is a Key Item in . It is obtained from the Lowe Blant on Turqos Plateau during Proof of Love. It must be given to Sarah in Auresco.
Rare Heart Glasses are Casual Wear head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Grenada Galactic Group.
Redesigned Sunglasses are Casual Wear head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Grenada Galactic Group.

Redesigned Sport Glasses are Casual Wear head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries. They are an upgraded version of the Bargain Sport Glasses and share their appearance with them.
Reed Piranhax (Japanese: , Rītore Samon) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Piranhax family, and can be found at level 13-19 on Serene Springside and Lyanne Meadow in Gormott.
Ray of Punishment (Japanese: , Panisshumentorei, lit. Punishment Ray) is Mythra's Level I Blade Special in .

Rambunctious Valcro is an unused Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Ropl family that would have been found at level 8 on Garanti Plain in the Gormott Province. It was shown in an early build of the game during the 2017 E3 Nintendo Treehouse Live presentation. It was cut from the game for unknown reasons.

Rainbow Carrots (Japanese: , Nijiironinjin) are collectables in . They can be found on the Bionis' Shoulder. According to their description, they are carrots with all the colours of the rainbow, and their flavour varies per hue. Three are needed for Hunting Help.

Ravager Apelpisía (Japanese: , Tōmetsu no Aperupisia) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Kromar family, and can be found at level 77 at Zekr Marga Quarry on the Bionis' Shoulder. Ravager Apelpisía is the third highest-levelled Unique Monster in , after Contemptuous Greymane and Prosecutor Davrum. It is the only source of Jumbo Fruitshot and Tenderheart Blocker with 2 and 3 empty gem slots, and it guards a Giants' Trove that contains the Sage Artistry. __TOC__

Ready, Setset, Go! (Japanese: , Nanana no Ketsui Hyōmei!) is a quest in . It can be received from Setset at above Old King's Testament on Bionis' Shoulder. Completing it will cause Setset to join the active Ponspector group.

The Ramrod Tirkin (Japanese: , Kizuyari no Tākin) is a Quest Exclusive Enemy in . It is a member of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 69 in the upper Navvir Highland on the Bionis' Shoulder during Hekasa's Labour at Stake. As with all Quest Exclusive Enemies in , the Ramrod Tirkin drops no chests.

Recharge is a game mechanic in and . After certain actions such as Battle Arts or Blade Specials are used, their recharge gauge becomes empty and needs to be filled by a specific amount before they can be recast again. Recharging an Art or Special is a mostly active process, requiring the use of Auto-Attacks or other Arts, but it can be helped by the use of Pouch Items and certain equipment or Affinity Chart skills. Multiple other factors such as higher Affinity or Cancelling Attacks will affect recharge, allowing for faster art and special use.
Redwood Amulets are light arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can only be worn by Kino.
Redwood Anklets are light feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can only be worn by Kino.
Redwood Hair Ties are light head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can only be worn by Kino.
Redwood Knapsacks are light legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can only be worn by Kino.
Redwood Vests are light torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. They can only be worn by Kino.
Redesigned Round Sunglasses are Casual Wear head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Grenada Galactic Group and are a part of the redesigned armor range.
Redeeming Strike (Japanese: , Ridīmusutoraiku, lit. "Redeem Strike") is Nia's Level III Blade Special in . Redeeming Strike is also Nia's Special Art during Merc Assault missions in the .
Rebel Sister (Japanese: , Shuvu~esutāriberion, Lit. "Schwester Rebellion") is Theory's Level III Blade Special in . Rebel Sister is also Theory's Special Art during Merc Assault missions in the .

Rattle Aspars are Normal Minor enemies in . They are members of the Aspar family, and can be found at level 14 - 15 at Racine's Platter in the Eagus Wilderness. One is also fought at level 43 during the second wave of the Challenge Battle Vampiric Rush.
Refreshing Rain (Japanese: , Buresshingurein) is a Talent Art in . It is the Talent Art of the Stalker class.
Rapid Shot (Japanese: , Rapiddoshūto) is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Stalker class.

Rambler Curalie (Japanese: , Hōkō no Kyurarī) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Caterpile family, and can be found at level 17 at Bennel Cave in Eagus Wilderness. The Poison Spray Art can be earned by the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

Raucous Ron (Japanese: , Kensō no Rinpusu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Flier family, and can be found at level 27 at Roaring Spring in the Urayan Tunnels. The Last Fencer Art can be earned by the Soulhacker class by defeating it.
The Raptor Perch (Japanese: , Kyochō no Sekimon) is a Landmark in . It is located in Dannagh Desert in the Fornis Region.
Ravoons are a family of aquatic enemies in and . They resemble large Sea dragons, and can be found throughout Erythia Sea.

Ravenous Babayaga (Japanese: , Bōshoku no Bābayaga) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Moglum family, and can be found at level 84 in Patulia Bay in Erythia Sea. The Attack Heal Skill can be earned by the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

Reaping Anteel (Japanese: , Inochi wo Ayatsuru Anatoeru) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Horrish family, and can be found at level 72 on the east side of Ferronis Arsenal #2 in the Origin Interior. The Healing Mastery Skill can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.
Red Nopon Pebbles are Key Items in . At least six must be collected from Nopon Merchants for the quest Nopon Register, although a seventh can be obtained from Ruggyscruggy.
Reasons to Evolve (Japanese: , Kawareru Riyū) is a Ascension Quest in , dedicated to Zeon.
Redrum Seeds are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Fornis Region. They can also be produced by the Tableland Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

|-|XC3 = |-|FR = Razzle Basils are Plant Collectibles in and . They can be found in the Aetia Region in . It can also be purchased from the Colony 9 Caravan. They can also be produced from the Hillside Ferronis Hulk Fabricator. They can be found on The Ragmos Desolation in .

Randakk Scorpoxes are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Scorpox family, and can be found at level 68-69 at the Apex Wing and in Ecto Hollow in Dannagh Desert. One is also fought at level 73 during the second wave of the Challenge Battle Men! Of! The Sea! IV.
Randster Ignas are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Igna family, and can be found at level 42-43 in Nid Cave and at Zain's Talon on Elaice Highway.
Rainbow Boronias are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be purchased from the Colony Mu Caravan, or produced from the Atoll Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Red Namekos are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Atoll Ferronis Hulk Fabricator or the Sandbar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Red-Veined Corals are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Sandbar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

Refreshing Piranhax Meats are items in and . They can be obtained from the Piranhax family. The common and rare variants can also be purchased from Sunny & Cheerio's Caravan. In , the rare variant can also be purchased from the Col. 9 Supply Office (New).

Ranger Gulkins are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Gulkin family, and can be found at level 45-46 on Daedal Isle, level 73-74 on Lavi Sandbar, and level 98-99 in the Malevolent Hollow in Erythia Sea.
Rasheen Garaffas are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Garaffa family, and can be found at level 46-47 in the Perimeter Woodland of Li Garte Prison Camp.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Rainbow Feather Bands are Accessories in and . The legendary variant can be obtained from Fineblade Faltaar. In , the legendary variant can be obtained from Tenebrous Muramasa.
The Reef Caravan is a shop in . It is run by a Traderpon on Hovering Reef 2 of the Syra Hovering Reefs.
Rations are Key Items in . They can be found around Everblight Plain and at the Gura Flava Lowlands in Alfeto Valley during Lean Times in Colony 9.

Rectangular Ori. Shards are Key Items in . They are Origin Shards. They are used to Upgrade Blades and enhance Crafted Accessories. They can be purchased for 9,000 red Noponstones at the Prize X-change Red, and 1,800 blue Noponstones at the Prize X-change Blue.
Redred is a Nopon NPC in . Redred can be found at the Tableland Ferronis Hulk in Rae-Bel Tableland after completing The Tableland Hulk.
Ranule Amoneys (Japanese: , Ranura Amonē) are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Amoney family, and can be found at level 49-52 in Yzana Plains and Millick Meadows.
Rebul Paguls are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Pagul family, and can be found at level 44-56 in Erythia Sea.
Rattlejack's Levnis (Japanese: ) is a Quest Exclusive Boss in . It is Rattlejack's Levnis, a Velites fought at level 66 in the Colony 11, Training Pit at Syra Hovering Reefs during Festival of War.
Rattlejack (Japanese: ) is a NPC in . Rattlejack can be found in Colony 11.
Redfish Grillwraps are Meal items in . They can be purchased from the Lambda Canteen. Purchasing it for the first time unlocks the recipe for the Squishy-Fishy Grillwrap for Manana's Menu.
Rank Splitter (Japanese: ) is a Battle Art in . It is one of the arts of the Thaumaturge class. The user does a hard staff swing to the left healing allies on hit.
Refractive Edge is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Noponic Champion class.
Rampaging Fists is a Battle Art in . It is a variant of Impulse Wave that can only be used by Ghondor.

Razor Wind (Japanese: , Tachikaze) is a Battle Art in . It is a variant of Hornet that can only be used by Isurd. He jumps then lands with a pose scattering sharp winds around and healing his comrades.
Ready-Steady (Japanese: , Kakugo o kimeru mo) is a Battle Art in . It is one of Riku & Manana's arts as a Hero, and is a variation on Determination used by Ouroboros members.
Rare Halfrim Glasses are Casual Wear head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Grenada Galactic Group.

Raid Strike is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Puzzled Raquinu while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

Reduce All is a Status Effect in . It reduces the affected character's attack, defense, accuracy and evasion, greatly weakening them. The debuff can only be inflicted through the use of the Origin Blade Talent Art. This Talent Art can be accessed by Noah's Ouroboros when he Interlinks while Unlimited Sword is active, or when Interlinking at level 3 after unlocking Unlimited Sword, in which case the Talent Art is only available when the Ouroboros is close to overheating.
|-|Normal = |-|Worn = |-| Advanced = Reginal Tecta Rs are Light Wear left arm armor in and . They are manufactured by Grenada Galactic Group and are apart of the Reginal armor range.
The Raguel Bridge Camp (Japanese: , Ragueru Ōhashi Dai-ichi Tō no Kyūsokuchi) is a Rest Spot in , located on the southern side of Raguel Bridge at The Ragmos Desolation.
Red-Hot Paean () is a Chain Art in . It is Glimmer's Chain Art during a Chain Attack.
The Rare Anlood Guts are a Key Item in . They are obtained by defeating the Gigante Anlood during A Melody Sustained. Miguel uses them to repair the lute found by Glimmer.
Red-Hot Cyclone () is Nikol & Glimmer's Chain Art in . This art is based on Glimmer's Red-Hot Paean and Nikol's Cyclone Form.
Red-Hot Aegislight () is Glimmer & Rex's Unity Chain Art in .
Ravamantine is a Key Item in . It must be collected at the Exile Fortress Ruins during the Scenario Quest Riku's Workshop. It is used to set up the furnace in Riku's Workshop in Colony 9.

Rapchors (Japanese: , Raputa) are dinosaur-like enemies in and . They are small creatures similar to dromaeosaurids. This species is close to Skwaror but Rapchors are yellow in color and have less dense plumage. A few named runners are used as scouts but this term can be used for other species.

Redeem the Future (known as Battle for the Future in Japanese) is a track from , composed by Manami Kiyota. It is track eleven of disc nine on the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track eleven of disc twenty from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during the first phase of the final battle against Alpha and the cutscene that proceeds it. The opening part of this song also plays during the opening cutscene, "Prologue", when Shulk, Rex, and Z confront Alpha. An instrumental version of the song also plays in Origin before initiating the final battle. This song also plays during Chain Attacks instead of the Chain Attack theme.

Redeem the Future - Finale (known as Final Battle for the Future in Japanese) is a track from , composed by Manami Kiyota. It is track twelve of disc nine on the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track twelve of disc twenty from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. It is a version of Redeem the Future with more prominent drums. This song plays during the second phase of the final battle against Alpha in Origin, as well as during the cutscene right before it. This song also plays during Chain Attacks instead of the standard Chain Attack theme.
Raid Aeviters are three Mission Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Aeviter family, and are fought at level 24-25 at Lake Ciel in Sylvalum during New Skell on the Block.
The Ravaged Vargo is an area in . It is located in Volitaris. One of the Shackle of Samaar is found here.

The Ramjet Rifle II is a unique ranged weapon in . It is a level 60 Assault Rifle of Common rarity, and is obtained as a reward from the Affinity Mission Rapid Misfire. It replicates the unique properties of the Ramjet Rifle from the , most notably its extremely high TP gain value. Although its stats show a sell price of 45 credits, it cannot be sold or discarded. Unlike the original Ramjet Rifle, L's Shop can be used to add up to three Augment slots.
Randhall is an NPC in . He is an Urayan who can be found in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Refantis is an NPC in . He is a Tantalese who can be found at the Soprac Old Market in the Kingdom of Tantal.

Reconnoiter Alrest with Elma is a series of tasks on Elma's Affinity Chart in . These involve taking Elma to five specific locations around Alrest, leading to a conversation between Elma and certain party members at each location, similar to Heart-to-Hearts. Viewing each scene will unlock a level of Elma's Keen Eye Field Skill and reveal the requirements to unlock the same levels of her Focus and Lockpicking Field Skills. These scenes must be viewed in a specific order.

Raguel Bridge (English dub: ) is a point of interest in . It is a bridge crossing Raguel Lake found on lower Bionis' Leg. At either end are the landmarks Raguel Bridge - North and Raguel Bridge - South. Shulk and his friends find Juju's buggy crashed into the side of this bridge after he runs off to Colony 6. There are some Hox located at the south end during The Road Home, and these must be defeated to complete the quest. According to Sharla, it is an old structure built around the time Colony 9 was founded.

Raguel Bridge - North (Japanese: , Ragueru Ōhashi Dai 2 Tō) is a landmark in . It is located at the northern end of Raguel Bridge crossing Raguel Lake found on the lower level of Bionis' Leg. The Heart-to-Heart "What Visions May Bring" is located here.
Rectifier Deadsights are ranged weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Sniper Rifles. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 396,000 Credits.
Rectifier Raidrifles are ranged weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Assault Rifles. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 330,000 Credits.
Rectifier Deadsights II are ranged weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Sniper Rifles. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 396,000 Credits.
Rectifier Sidearms are ranged weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Dual Guns. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 363,000 Credits.
Ranged Accuracy Down is a debuff in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It reduces ranged attack accuracy.

Reyn (Japanese: , Rain, Rein; English dub: ) is one of the seven playable characters in and one of Shulk's childhood friends. He is the second character introduced into the game after Shulk. Although he is a member of Colony 9's Defence Force, he can often be seen at Shulk and Fiora's side. Reyn becomes playable in the beginning of Chapter 1. He fights using an oversized Gunlance, which can switch from shield mode into gun or lance mode.

Rocco (Japanese: , Roko) is a Homs in . He can be found in the Gem Man's Stall in Colony 9 from 9:00 - 15:00, and from 15:00 - 18:00, he can be found in the northern portion of the Commercial District. After completing Rocco's Heartful Request he can be found in front of Dunban's House playing with Liliana.

Retro Diodes (Japanese: , Retoro Daiōdo) are collectables in . They can be found in Mechonis Field and Colony 6. According to their description, they are archaic diodes with red lights that are always on. Two are required for the reconstruction of Colony 6. In the , they can be purchased in Time Attack place from Nopon Archsage for 13,800 Noponstones.

Ridge Antols are enemies in . They are members of the Antol family, and can be found in Colony 9 in the cave below Outlook Park and the shore near Anti-Air Battery 1. Two of them must be defeated to complete Colony 9's Monster Quest 1 - Part 1.

Ricoth (Japanese: , Riko) is a High Entia NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles. She can be found in Alcamoth, northeast of the Fountain of Eternity, around the escalator, near Rozeal. After the events at the Mechonis Core (during Chapter 16), Ricoth is among the ones transformed into a Telethia, and thusly cannot be interacted with anymore.

Rizaka (Japanese: , Reana) is a Machina in Xenoblade Chronicles. Initially she can be found in front of the sparking door of her home, which is located near the shop. After Fixing a Broken Door is completed she can be found near the Ether Light.

Rocco's Heartful Request (Japanese: , Roko no Setsujitsuna Negai) is a quest in . It can be received from Rocco in a tent near the Gem Man's Stall in the Commercial District of Colony 9. If Shulk is in the active party, he will comment. After this quest is completed, Dean may offer Dean's Shady Request.

Riki's House (Japanese: , Riki no Ie) is a landmark in . It is located on the fourth floor of Frontier Village. It is where Riki, his wife Oka, and his children live. Gowago can also be found close by, slightly to the north of the house. There is a Heart-to-Heart here, between Dunban and Riki - "Life's Hard for a Heropon".

Rest in Peace (Japanese: , Yasurakaninemure) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Satata at the Reconstruction HQ in Colony 6. This quest is available after completing Satata's Younger Brother. The Mushroom Cap he gives the party must be thrown off where a great waterfall can be seen. The location is marked with a red exclamation mark at the Divine Sanctuary in Makna Forest. If Shulk is in the active party, he will comment.
Rescue Caps (Japanese: , Resukyū Kyappu) are light head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Rescue Tops are light torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by various enemies.
Regnas Boots are medium feet armour in . They can be dropped by Lake Flamii. They were developed by Homs during the last war between Bionis and Mechonis.
Rex Chests are heavy torso armour in . They can be dropped by various high-level enemies.
Rex Cuisses are heavy legs armour in . They can be dropped by various enemies.

Regnas Gear (Japanese: , Regunasu Gia) is medium head armour in . It was developed by Homs during the first war against Mechonis, which culminated with the Battle of Sword Valley. It can be dropped by Cute Brogs, or be traded for with Dorothy.
Regnas Gauntlets are medium arms armour in . They can be dropped by Cute Brogs. They were developed for Homs soldiers during the war with Mechonis, prior to the Battle of Sword Valley.
Regnas Armour (Japanese: , Regunasu Āmā) is medium torso armour in . It was developed by Homs during the first war against Mechonis, which culminated with the Battle of Sword Valley.

Retrieved Armour is medium torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be dropped by Offensive/LYRICs, or can be obtained as a quest reward from Daring Assault. According to its description, Mechon took this armour from Homs soldiers during "an ancient war", possibly the first war between Bionis and Mechonis that included the first Battle of Sword Valley.
Retrieved Gear (Japanese: , Kaishū Nanagō Gia) is medium head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.

Regnas Leggings are medium legs armour in . They were developed by Homs during the last war between Bionis and Mechonis, which culminated with the Battle of Sword Valley. They can be dropped by Daughter Armus.
Retrieved Leggings are medium legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They were taken by the Mechon from the Homs during the first war between Bionis and Mechonis.

Rho Oasis (Japanese: , Rō no Oashisu) is a location in . It is located on the lower level of Bionis' Leg. It is a small oasis, filled with ruined pillars, just south of the entrance to the Tirkin Headquarters. This is where Shulk and Reyn meet Juju after rescuing him from a pair of Berserk Ardun. It is inhabited only by a few Fine Fliers during the day, and Light Wisps during the night. A Heart-to-Heart - "Revisiting the Past" - is located here.
Retrieved Gauntlets are medium arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Retrieved Boots are medium feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by various Mechon in Agniratha.

Resplendent Flamiis are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Flamii family, and can be found in Colony 9, mainly around Anti-Air Battery 2. Lower-level ones can be found on the coastline to the east of the Military District. They may be next to the Unique Monster named Flailing Bracken.
Resolution - Father (Japanese: , Mondai Kaiketsu: Papa-hen) is a quest in . It can be received from Kazat in the Hidden Machina Village on the Fallen Arm during Mending Memories.
Rex Helms (Japanese: , Rekkusu Herumu) are heavy head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by various enemies and be obtained as quest rewards after completing various quests.
Rex Arms are heavy arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are made by the Machina.
Rigel Hands (Japanese: , Rigeruhansu) are weapons in . They are gunlances wielded by Reyn, and can be obtained from numerous high-leveled enemies. Rigel Hands are not otherwise obtainable.

Reward Defenders (Japanese: , Hōshō no Gotō) are Unique weapons in . They are swords wielded by Dunban, and are equipped with gems which increase EXP and AP. Weapons with the same gem effects for other characters are the Bonus Driver, Bonus Sniper, Bonus Staff, Reward Nibbler and Reward Swords.
The Rex Biter (Japanese: , Hadō no Bakubaku) is a weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a biter wielded by Riki.

Reward Nibblers (Japanese: , Hōshō no Bakubaku) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are biters wielded by Riki, and can be obtained from high-leveled enemies. They are not otherwise available. Weapons that have the same effect as the Reward Nibbler for other characters are the Bonus Driver, Bonus Sniper, Reward Defender, Bonus Staff, and Reward Swords.

Reward Swords (Japanese: , Hōshō no Sōken) are Unique weapons in . They are Fiora's twin blades, and although they are by far her worst in terms of stats, they are equipped with gems which increase EXP and AP. Weapons with the same gem effects for other characters are the Bonus Driver, Bonus Sniper, Reward Defender, Bonus Staff and Reward Nibbler.
Rescue Bottoms are light legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.

Restoring the Capital (Japanese: , Kōto wo Fukkōsuru tameni) is a quest in . It can be received from Nelo at the south of Entry Bridge landmark in Frontier Village. If Fiora is in the active party, she will comment. When the fifth Aora Telethia is defeated, the surprise quest Vidian Rescue Mission in Alcamoth is automatically triggered.

Restoring the Capital 2 (Japanese: , Kōto wo Fukkōsuru tameni 2) is a quest in . It can be received from Nelo after completing Restoring the Capital. Two different types of material are required from the Fallen Arm and the High Entia Tomb. If Dunban is in the active party, he will comment.

Repaired Bridge Four (Japanese: , Fukkatsu shita Tsuribashi) is a location in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is located in Makna Forest. It is the fourth of four bridges in Makna Forest that cross the main river and is located furthest north of these bridges, just above Bridge Three. As the name suggests, it is repaired after completing Bridge Repair.

The Reservoir (Japanese: , Chosuichi) is a location in . It is located in the basement of Frontier Village. Empress Beetles can be found here, which three are needed for the reconstruction of Colony 6.

The Reinforcement M104 (Japanese: , Zōentai Hyakuyonshiki) is a quest exclusive enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is found in Sword Valley, behind the 3rd Gate and has to be defeated as part of the surprise quest 3rd Gate Front Line.
Revival HP Up (Japanese: , Fukkatsu HP Appu) is a Gem in that increases the amount of HP that an Incapacitated character recovers when revived. __TOC__

Resolute Arachnos (Japanese: , Shūchaku no Supaido) are a group of four quest exclusive enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Arachno family, and can be found on the first floor of Vilia Lake in Tephra Cave. They only appear during the quest Clearing Obstructions, where four of them must be defeated.

Reversed Tastes (Japanese: , Abekobe Gurume) is a quest in . It can be received from Kofuko in the armour shop at the Central Plaza in Frontier Village. If Dunban is in the active party, he will comment. This quest and World's Strongest Flavour are mutually exclusive.

Replica Monado 1 (Japanese: , Monado Repurika 1) is a quest in . It can be received from Vanea on the control deck of Junks after it lands in the Bionis' Interior. Although listed in the quest log as amongst Colony 6 Quests, it can be received while Junks is in Colony 6, the Hidden Machina Village, or the Bionis' Interior. Replica Monado 2, Replica Monado 3, Replica Monado 4 and Replica Monado 5 are also received when this quest is accepted.

Replica Monado 2 (Japanese: , Monado Repurika 2) is a quest in . It is received automatically when Replica Monado 1 is accepted, along with Replica Monado 3, Replica Monado 4 and Replica Monado 5. These quests can be received from Vanea on the control deck of Junks after it lands in Bionis' Interior. Although listed in the quest log amongst Colony 6 Quests, they can be received while Junks is in Colony 6, the Hidden Machina Village, or Bionis' Interior.

Replica Monado 3 (Japanese: , Monado Repurika 3) is a quest in . It is received automatically when Replica Monado 1 is accepted, along with Replica Monado 2, Replica Monado 4 and Replica Monado 5. These quests can be received from Vanea on the control deck of Junks after it lands in the Bionis' Interior. Although listed in the quest log amongst Colony 6 Quests, they can be received while Junks is in Colony 6, the Hidden Machina Village, or the Bionis' Interior.

Replica Monado 4 (Japanese: , Monado Repurika 4) is a quest in . It is received automatically when Replica Monado 1 is accepted, along with Replica Monado 2, Replica Monado 3 and Replica Monado 5. These quests can be received from Vanea on the control deck of Junks after it lands in the Bionis' Interior. Although listed in the quest log amongst Colony 6 Quests, they can be received while Junks is in Colony 6, the Hidden Machina Village, or the Bionis' Interior.

Replica Monado 5 (Japanese: , Monado Repurika 5) is a quest in . It is received automatically when Replica Monado 1 is accepted, along with Replica Monado 2, Replica Monado 3 and Replica Monado 4. These quests can be received from Vanea on the control deck of Junks after it lands in the Bionis' Interior. Although listed in the quest log amongst Colony 6 Quests, they can be received while Junks is in Colony 6, the Hidden Machina Village, or the Bionis' Interior.
Reinforced Plates are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by various bipedal Mechon in Mechonis Field and Central Factory.
Reinforced Lenses are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from various Defensive-type Mechon, or by trading with Bozatrox.

Riki is Angry (Japanese: , Okotta mo) is one of Riki's arts in . It activates an aura that gives Riki a Counter Spike effect, countering all non-Talent Art damage received by dealing two, four (rarely), or eight (very rarely) times the amount of damage to the attacker. It does not affect the amount of damage received by Riki.

Resolution - Mother (Japanese: , Mondai Kaiketsu: Mama-hen) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Qofaria in the Hidden Machina Village on the Fallen Arm during Mending Memories.

The Repulsive Portrait is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is given to the party by Matryona, who instructs it to be delivered to Ewan if the party gives her the Nasty Weed instead of the Lake Drop during Matryona's Answer.

Rhogul Axe Crests are rare materials in . They can be dropped by low-level Rhoguls in Satorl Marsh or traded for with Rozeal after the events of Mechonis Core. According to their description, they are tough little crests that though they are small, they look intimidating. Three are needed for Bridge Repair.

Rhoen Quadwings (Japanese: , Rōen Kurōdo) are enemies in . They are members of the Quadwing family, and can be found at level 92 along the Bone Corridor north of the Vilia Lake landmark in Tephra Cave. They can drop the Quadwing Treasure needed for Replica Monado 2.

The Research Data are two Key Items in Xenoblade Chronicles. One is given by Mefimefi and is required for Safer Energy. It is data needed to alter Red Pollen Orbs. Another one is given by Daza and is required for Distilling Active Ingredients.

Reunion with Fiora (Japanese: , Fiorun to no Saikai) is a Story Quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is received upon arriving at the Wreckage Beach on the Fallen Arm. Once the quest is triggered, the Silver Wreckage location is unveiled.
Residential District 2 (Japanese: , Dai-2 Kyojūku) is a location in . It is located on the ground floor of Agniratha, north of the Central Tower. It leads to the Calcos Pillar.

Residential District 1 (Japanese: , Dai-1 Kyojūku) is a location in . It is located on the ground floor of Agniratha, between the Factory Transporter and the Central Tower. Although it is next to the Cleas Pillar, the pillar cannot be reached from here. There are no enemies in this location.
Rich Sardi Meat are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Sardis in Makna Forest, or be traded for.
Reinforced Units are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by two M70-type Mechon in Mechonis Field, or traded for with Bozatrox.

Reinforced Cores are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from the Magestic Mordred and M108/SPADE units in the Central Factory, and are not available for trade. According to their description, they are fairly resilient parts that should stay strong for 100 years. Reinforced Jets, Reinforced Plungers, and Reinforced Thrusters share this description.
Rich Krabble Eggs are rare materials in . They are dropped by various Krabbles in the Ether Mine, and can also be traded for.
Revisiting the Past (Japanese: , Futatabi Otozureta Basho) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located by Rho Oasis on the Bionis' Leg, between Sharla and Dunban at pink affinity.

Renewed Determination (Japanese: , Aratana Ketsui) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at the Freight Elevator in Colony 6, between Reyn and Shulk at pink affinity. It can only be viewed after the events at Mechonis Core.

Riki's Crazy Crystal Plan (Japanese: , Ēteru Kesshō Daisakusen, The Great Ether Crystal Operation) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at the Eks Watering Hole in Makna Forest, between Reyn and Riki at purple affinity.
Riki Have Question (Japanese: , Riki no Shiritai Koto) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located in the Syrath Lighthouse in Eryth Sea, between Fiora and Riki at pink affinity.

Research Probes are types of Data Probes in Xenoblade Chronicles X. These probes permit remote viewing of a segment for citizens of New Los Angeles, generating tourism revenue (credits) through FrontierNav Sites. The higher the probe's level, the more Revenue Total the probe will produce. Linking Research Probes of the same grade in a 3/5/8+ chain will increase their effectiveness. By discovering Sightseeing Spots (Unexplored Territories and Scenic Viewpoints) near an FN Site with a Research Probe installed, the amount of Credits revenue will increase. For example a G2 Research Probe placed on a FN Site with two nearby discovered Sightseeing Spots will yield a revenue each cycle of 2 times 2

Riki the Legendary Heropon (伝説の勇者リキ, Riki the Legendary Hero) is an Event Track in , composed and arranged by ACE+. It is track 21 of disc 1 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is a lighthearted, comedic theme that is heard during the cutscene when Shulk happens across Colonel Vangarre berating a couple Defence Force Soldiers in the Military District, and later when Chief Dunga introduces the titular Heropon Riki to the party in Frontier Village. In , this song plays during the following moments: * When the party meets Tentoo. * When Nene slaps Kino away for trying to use Tranquilsnooze on Melia. * When Wunwun plans on finding the treasure during Priority Wunwun. * After the P

Riki's Kindness (リキの優しさ, Riki's Tenderness) is an Event Track in , composed and arranged by ACE+. It is track 5 of disc 2 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is a heartwarming theme that plays when Riki gives good advice to Dunban regarding Shulk and Fiora while they and Melia are making camp at Inlet Beach on the Fallen Arm. This theme continues the next morning when the three break camp and Riki leads them through the pipe, confident that their companions will be on the other side. This theme also plays is when continuing a new game from saved data when the player must decide which items to carry over. In , this theme plays at the end of Inclined to Climb, when Nene tells Sh

Reminiscence (回想) is an Event Track in , composed and arranged by Manami Kiyota. It is track 12 of disc 1 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack, and track four of disc four from the Xenoblade Definitive Edition Original Soundtrack and the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This music is a heartwarming theme that is heard during the cutscene when Riki brings Dunban a fish to eat while making camp and letting Melia rest at Inlet Beach on the Fallen Arm, and later during Vanea's conversation with Fiora about Meyneth on the deck of the Junks en route to the Central Factory. In , this song plays during the flashback of Shulk convincing Melia to go to Alcamoth on the Junks.

The Repenta Diner (Japanese: , Dainā) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles. This place was simply named Diner in early builds of the game.
The Restricted Hangar Entrance (Japanese: , Kakuri Kakunōko-zen) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.

The Rock Cavern (Japanese: , Iwa Dōkutsu) is an Unexplored Territory in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a cave located at the north of the Silent Mire in Primordia. Monsters of levels between 30 and 40 can be found here, as well as a reasonable amount of treasure. Discovering this location is one of the objectives for the Normal Mission The Probe-fessional.

Renewed Will (Japanese: , Rifuresshu) is an Affinity Mission in . It can be received in the Commercial District, near Central Melville Street. This mission is a prerequisite to start Chapter 5, and is centered on Irina.

Rock Ciniculas (Japanese: , Rokku Vasaruto) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Cinicula family, and can be found at level 27-29 in Noctilum, near FN Site 208 or FN Site 218.
River Suids (Japanese: , Ribā Zūsu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Suid family, and can be found at level 9-10 near FN Site 209 in Noctilum.
The River Isle (Japanese: , Ribā Sentoraru, River Central) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Oblivia, northwest of FN Site 312 and east of Aaroy Plain.

Ripper Vespers (Japanese: , Rippā Usuperu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Vesper family, and can be found at level 41-42 in the entrance to Rockmole's Burrow in Noctilum.
Rizattices (Japanese: , Rizattisu) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia, in particular inside several caves. Three of them are needed for Mission A.
Repair is a Support Battle Art in . It restores an ally's HP and removes all debuffs.
Robert (Japanese: , Robāto) is a Human NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the Central Industrial District in New Los Angeles. He is a member of the Pathfinders Division.

Ridill, the Arrogant is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Harriers and the primary destination is Primordia. It is a request to defeat the titular Ridill, the Arrogant.
River Isle BC (Japanese: , Ribā Sentoraru BC, River Central BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a BLADE base camp located in Oblivia, on the River Isle.
Rock-Oranges (Japanese: , Rokkurenji) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia.
Rock Armadillos (Japanese: , Arunajikku) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum. Eight are required for Proficiency Exam 5.

Resonating Madonaters (Japanese: , Kyōmeigata Maddonētā) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum, in particular near FN Site 215 or the Great Nail. One is needed during Definian Downfall A route.

River Papils (Japanese: , Ribā Papirio) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Papil family, and can be found at level 21-22 just off the northeast shore of Janpath Lake in Primordia at daytime.
Robust Evello Horns are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Evellos.

Reward Tickets in or Material Tickets in are reward items. They are received when the Squad completes Squad Tasks and Squad Missions, regardless of individual participation, and additional tickets are received by the players who completed the tasks and missions. Tickets can also be obtained by exchanging Appendage Fragments via the "Global Nemesis Battle Spoils" option at the Network Console. Completing the survey of Mira awards the player with 5,000 Reward/Material Tickets. In the original version, Reward Tickets can be exchanged via the Network Console's "Use Reward Tickets" option for a wide range of Materials, including many that otherwise are difficult to obtain. In the , this function

Ro-darm the Demon Claw (Japanese: , Madzume no Ro-Damu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is an Oc-serv machine. It can be found at level 38 southeast of North Coast in Oblivia. It must be defeated for Squad Mission No.14.
Rising Renewal is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Shield Trooper at rank 5. It increases the amount of health recovered when revived. Cross, Frye, and Nagi can use this skill.

Rise of the Blood Lobster (Japanese: , Akaki Shinigami no Chōsen, The Crimson Reaper's Challenge) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from the Blood Lobster at the Outfitters Test Hangar in the Industrial District in New Los Angeles. A red toy lobster can be found at the left side of the hangar to trigger the mission. Red light signals can be seen where the Stuffed Lobsters are.

The Rexoskell (Japanese: , Turudūru) is a Mission Exclusive Secondary Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. This Skell enemy belongs to a unique subcategory in the Enemy Index. It is piloted by ER001: Emeroa and is fought twice during Definian Downfall, first at level 50 at the Ganglion Antropolis in Cauldros, then at level 54 on the Emerian Battlegrounds. After completing Definian Downfall, the Rexoskell can be battled again in the Gone Berserk Time Attack Mission. A level 40 version can be fought in the Corporate Espionage Squad Mission. When fighting the Rexoskell for the first time, the track Z37b20a13t01t08le plays. When fighting it for the second time as well as during Gone Berserk, the trac

Remote Puges (Japanese: , Rimōto Berude) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Puge machines, Ganglion's human size robots, and can be found at level 31-40 at the north edge of Primordia Waters.

Remote Pugiliths (Japanese: , Rimōto Berudero) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Pugilith machines, Ganglion's vehicles, and can be found at level 31-40 on the archipelago in the northern Primordia Waters.

Revolver Eagle Galdr (Japanese: , Riboruīguru Garudora) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Galdr machines, Ganglion vehicles, and can be found at level 55 at the top level of the path leading from Sea Whisper Valley to Jair Fortress in Oblivia.
Reject Oc-servs (Japanese: , Rijekuto Me-Tsuu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Oc-serv machines, and can be found at level 60 in Quay Hollows in Sylvalum.

Rhenium Fal-swos (Japanese: , Reniumu Gi-suo) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Fal-swo machines, and can be found at level 51-60 near the top of a tall thin tower in Cauldros's Kw'arah Cloister.
Resistant Flesh is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Mastermind at rank 6. Cross and Mia can use this skill.
Research is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is one of the missions H.B. issues during the affinity mission A New Rival?.

Rescue at the Ensconced Citadel (Japanese: , Ōiwa Yōsai Kyūshutsu Sakusen) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received by Julius to the right side of BLADE Tower in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles. This mission introduces the party to the Orpheans. Upon completion of this mission, the arms manufacturer Orphean Technologies is unlocked. Although it's not required the Basic Mission Top-Secret Mission (Julius) can be used to locate this mission.
Reporting for Duty (Japanese: , Shimei) is an Affinity Mission in . It can be received from outside BLADE Tower in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.
Revolver Barrager Zigs (Japanese: , Riborubaretto Jigu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Zig machines, and can be found at level 31-40 in Cauldros's Boxtrap Checkpoint.
Revolver Gunner Zigs (Japanese: , Riborukyanon Jigu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Zig machines, and can be found at level 41-50 in Oblivia, northwest of FN Site 307.
Relaxing Angel Wings are a casual head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Another pair of wings, the Soothing Angel Wings, are available in black.
Rin'luarb is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is an Orphean.
Resist HP Recovery Down is a ground armor debuff resistance augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases resistance to HP Recovery Down by 5 to 100.
Resist Thermal Res Down is a ground armor debuff resistance augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases resistance to Thermal Res Down by 5 to 100. The Skell equivalent is Resist.THERM-DOWN.
Resist Electric Res Down is a ground armor debuff resistance augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases resistance to Electric Res Down by 5 to 100. The Skell equivalent is Resist.ELEC-DOWN.
Resist Ether Res Down is a ground armor debuff resistance augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases resistance to Ether Res Down by 5 to 100. the Skell equivalent is Resist.ETHER-DOWN.
Resist Gravity Res Down is a ground armor debuff resistance augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases resistance to Gravity Res Down by 5 to 100. The Skell equivalent is Resist.GRAV-DOWN.
Resist Beam Res Down is a ground armor debuff resistance augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases resistance to Beam Res Down by 5 to 100. The Skell equivalent is Resist.BEAM-DOWN.

Resist Phys Res Down is a ground armor Debuff resistance Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases resistance to the Physical Res Down Battle Effect by 5 to 100. The Skell equivalent is Resist.PHYS-DOWN.
Ridding Insidias is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Prospectors and the primary destination is Oblivia.
Ringstone is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Lavina Couba asks the party to obtain it during Forbidden Love, and it must be delivered to Leroy.

Rendezvous at the Lab! is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Veven and the primary destination is the Industrial District of New Los Angeles. This mission leads into the Normal Mission Professor B's Return, although this mission itself is not a prerequisite.

Rexoskell Suckers are intergalactic materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are components in crafting the non-Ares level 60 Skell Frames. They can be obtained from the Time Attack Mission exclusive Rexoskell or from the Network Console for 210 Reward Tickets or 475 Material Tickets in .

Rhenium Oc-servs (Japanese: , Reniumu Me-Tsuu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Oc-serv machines, and can be found at level 51-60 in Cauldros's Kitsune Stronghold, Old Ceremonial Hollow or Ganglion Antropolis.
Rites of Ruin (Japanese: , Furejii no Gishiki, Fraisie's Ritual) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Jalimbo at the Cathedral in the Residential District.
Rich Scintimure Meat are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Scintimures.
Reverse Colubrim Fins are prime materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Colubrims.
The Repair Kit is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It's received from Satie near the East Gate in the Administrative District after accepting Myles to Go.
Research on a Budget is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a male BLADE and the primary destination is Noctilum.
